tickets.title: Faction role framework: six roles
tickets.description: Incumbent, Challenger, Parasite, Custodian, Refusenik, Herald as authored roles the seed casts. 5-7 active per world.

tickets.title: Incumbent mapping from the Powers axiom
tickets.description: Archonate, Hellenotamiai, Garrison, Council, plus the Poleis and Dark Age special cases.

tickets.title: Parasite mapping from the Law axiom
tickets.description: Metallarchs, Hekatombaia, Telestai, Horistai, Thesauroi, Horkos-brokers. One archetype, six faces.

tickets.title: Herald mapping from the Pressure axiom
tickets.description: Miastores, the hastening vigil, the Kerykes. People who want the prophecy fulfilled, not monsters - a prophecy can be joined, subverted or raced.

tickets.title: Challenger archetypes: Archaists, Diadochoi, Isonomoi
tickets.description: Each with a true diagnosis and a bad prescription. Diadochoi and isonomia are real terms.

tickets.title: Custodian archetypes: Mnemones and Periegetes
tickets.description: Mnemones were a real civic office holding what was not written down; periegetes are why we have Pausanias. The latter sell map knowledge as their reward currency.

tickets.title: Refusenik archetypes: Asebeis and Xenoi
tickets.description: The Asebeis set down the rites on principle and are named by their enemies. The Xenoi move under guest-right and can offer services anywhere.

tickets.title: Territory flood-fill with per-faction claim strategies
tickets.description: Resource-following, contiguous-with-distance-decay, harbours-only, defensive-isolated, routes-not-territory, expanding-over-time.

tickets.title: Contested cell identification
tickets.description: Overlapping claims mark the map's content sites - where danger, quests and interesting NPCs go.

tickets.title: Computed hostility matrix
tickets.description: Derive from ideological distance (restore/preserve/replace, control/free/renounce) plus resource overlap. Produces reasoned alliances and exploitable odd bedfellows.

tickets.title: Faction name composition
tickets.description: Role plus a noun the axioms produced - salt, ash, bronze, oath, tide, ichor, laurel. Names cohere within a seed automatically.

tickets.title: Faction standing system with gated unlocks
tickets.description: Standing gates trainers, stock, bases and safe passage. The only progression axis that can go negative.

tickets.title: Enforce: at least two factions want strictly incompatible things
tickets.description: Validation pass. If everyone can be satisfied, there was never a decision.

tickets.title: Faction visual identity via material parameters
tickets.description: Colour, silhouette motif and material treatment applied to shared meshes. One hoplite mesh becomes six factions. Doc 16.

tickets.title: Audible territory layer
tickets.description: Work-bells, patrol horns, silence. Crossing a border becomes audible before it becomes visible. Doc 12.
